Welcomed कृष्ण after the Kuru- क्षेत्र war; went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse; here he met the sages and asked them how to get rid of karma by karma. नारद's praise of. The sages induced him to undertake a sacrifice; requested by Vasudeva to be his ऋत्विक्स् for the यज्ञ they agreed. At the end of the sacrifice, he had his अवभृत with all his eighteen wives to the great satisfaction of राम and कृष्ण, when all castes and even animals were fed; others were honoured with presents. At leave-taking Vasudeva took hold of Nanda's hands and showed that the tie of friendship was the greatest of all ties and wept in joy. Gave Nanda presents; praise of कृष्ण and राम and his joy.
